$Comment: Cut stone and brick: every brick (stone, smooth, decorative, beam, pillar, wall, roof, stairs and slabs, clay and snow brick too) and vanilla's processed stone, named by id since no native tag tells them from the raw rock or soil they are cut from. A grant bound While ZigHolding with Items BlockFamily:Cut_Stone counts while one is in hand, so a thrift bonus on placing cut stone needs no stat of its own. A block joins any family by naming it in its own item Tags under ZigBlockFamily, so another mod opts its blocks in from its own files. Retune or switch it off by id in mods/ziggfreedcommon/block-families.json.
